meta.source: shepetal landing page (canvas 'shepetal hero concepts', board 5 'the full scroll story') for look; shepetal Brand 3.0 for voice, spacing, motion and the indicator.

tokens.name: sh-stone-0
tokens.usage: Field: text inputs and search on the concrete ground.

tokens.name: sh-stone-50
tokens.usage: Raised by day: cards, the meeting reminder, secondary keycaps (landing page reminder card).

tokens.name: sh-stone-100
tokens.usage: Concrete, the day ground (sh-bg in light); text and primary keycap in dark (the landing page ground).

tokens.name: sh-stone-150
tokens.usage: Sunken by day: wells, sidebars, selected rows.

tokens.name: sh-stone-200
tokens.usage: Ramp step with no fixed role.

tokens.name: sh-stone-300
tokens.usage: The side of a light keycap (its 3 px travel shadow).

tokens.name: sh-stone-350
tokens.usage: Muted text at night: 6.8:1 on night, 6.3:1 on night raised.

tokens.name: sh-stone-400
tokens.usage: The side of the light primary keycap at night; disabled text only.

tokens.name: sh-stone-500
tokens.usage: Ramp step with no fixed role.

tokens.name: sh-stone-600
tokens.usage: Ink 2, muted text by day: 5.9:1 on concrete, 5.4:1 on sunken (the landing page's secondary ink).

tokens.name: sh-stone-700
tokens.usage: Ramp step with no fixed role.

tokens.name: sh-stone-800
tokens.usage: Secondary keycaps at night.

tokens.name: sh-stone-850
tokens.usage: Raised at night: cards, panels, the reminder.

tokens.name: sh-stone-900
tokens.usage: Ink: text by day (14.4:1 on concrete), the primary keycap by day, the night ground.

tokens.name: sh-stone-950
tokens.usage: Sunken and fields at night; the side of a dark keycap.

tokens.name: sh-signal-400
tokens.usage: Signal as text at night: links, focus, signal words. 6.4:1 on night.

tokens.name: sh-signal-500
tokens.usage: Signal: the fn key, the LED, the caret, the recording ring, the live fill. A fill or a mark, never text on concrete (2.6:1).

tokens.name: sh-signal-600
tokens.usage: The lit face of the fn key while pressed.

tokens.name: sh-signal-700
tokens.usage: The side of the fn key (its travel).

tokens.name: sh-signal-800
tokens.usage: Signal as text by day: links, focus, signal words. 5.5:1 on concrete, 5.0:1 on sunken.

tokens.name: sh-signal-950
tokens.usage: The LED when off.

tokens.name: sh-led-on
tokens.usage: The LED when lit, and its glow.

tokens.name: sh-bg
tokens.usage: The window and page ground: concrete by day, night by night.

tokens.name: sh-bg-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, menus, the meeting reminder, on sh-bg.

tokens.name: sh-bg-sunken
tokens.usage: The sidebar, wells, the selected row, hover on quiet buttons.

tokens.name: sh-bg-field
tokens.usage: Text inputs, search fields, the dictionary editor.

tokens.name: sh-border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: row dividers, card edges, the header rule (ink at 22 %, as on the landing page). Decorative only.

tokens.name: sh-border-strong
tokens.usage: Control edges that must be seen: inputs, toggles, segmented controls. 3.3:1 on sh-bg in both themes.

tokens.name: sh-text
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on sh-bg (14.4:1 both themes), sh-bg-raised and sh-bg-sunken.

tokens.name: sh-text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, the mono labels. On sh-bg 5.9:1 light, 6.8:1 dark; on sh-bg-sunken 5.4:1 light, 7.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: sh-text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls only. Below 4.5:1 by design; never for text people must read.

tokens.name: sh-signal
tokens.usage: Live: the fn key, the LED, the caret, the recording ring, a pressed-and-held state. One signal mark per view. A fill or a mark, never text on a light ground.

tokens.name: sh-on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on an sh-signal fill: ink, 5.5:1.

tokens.name: sh-accent
tokens.usage: Signal as text: links, the focus ring, list dots, a signal word. On sh-bg 5.5:1 light, 6.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: sh-focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: 2 px solid, 2 px outside. 5.0:1 or better on every ground.

tokens.name: sh-primary-fill
tokens.usage: The one primary keycap per view: ink by day, concrete by night.

tokens.name: sh-primary-hover
tokens.usage: The primary keycap under the pointer.

tokens.name: sh-primary-side
tokens.usage: The side of the primary keycap: its 4 px travel.

tokens.name: sh-on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on sh-primary-fill: 14.4:1.

tokens.name: sh-key-fill
tokens.usage: Secondary keycaps and inline key hints.

tokens.name: sh-key-side
tokens.usage: The side of a secondary keycap: its 3 px travel.

tokens.name: sh-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors, always with their word and the alert icon. On sh-bg 6.0:1 light, 8.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: sh-state-recording
tokens.usage: The indicator ring: Recording, and the whole time a meeting records. A full ring.

tokens.name: sh-state-hands-free
tokens.usage: The indicator ring: Hands-free. Same signal, told apart by shape: a ring with a gap at the top.

tokens.name: sh-state-writing
tokens.usage: The indicator ring: Writing. An ink ring that pulses; at rest under reduced motion.

tokens.name: sh-note-label
tokens.usage: The short message beside the indicator in the note state: black at 75 %.

tokens.name: sh-note-text
tokens.usage: Text of that message, on sh-note-label (12.6:1 over concrete).

families.ui: Archivo, "Helvetica Neue", "Segoe UI", Ubuntu, Cantarell, system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "Fragment Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", "DejaVu Sans Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Web
groups.note: Archivo at 520, tight tracking. Sizes are the landing page's at 1440 x 900; on the site they are fluid: clamp(min, N * u, max) with u = min(1vw, 1.6vh).

styles.name: web-display
styles.usage: The hero line. clamp(2.5rem, 5.3u, 10rem). One per page.

styles.name: web-h2
styles.usage: Sub-claims under a chapter head. clamp(1.35rem, 2.3u, 4rem).

styles.name: web-lead
styles.usage: The line under a head, in sh-text-muted. clamp(1.2rem, 1.9u, 3.2rem).

styles.name: web-body
styles.sample: Your recordings are in a folder on your Mac.
styles.usage: Running text on the site: the privacy, terms and legal pages, help.

styles.name: web-cta
styles.usage: Text on keycap buttons on the site.

groups.name: App
groups.note: The desktop scale, the same on Mac, Linux and Windows. Never below weight 420 or 11px: thin Archivo breaks up under Windows ClearType.

styles.name: app-title
styles.usage: The screen title: Home, History, Meetings, Settings, Dictionary.

styles.name: app-heading
styles.usage: Group heads inside a screen; window titles of dialogs.

styles.name: app-body
styles.sample: Accessibility lets shepetal paste your text where your cursor is.
styles.usage: All interface text: rows, buttons, menus, dictated text in History.

styles.name: app-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, the row label that names a setting, the selected nav item.

styles.name: app-small
styles.usage: Help under a control, secondary row text, menu shortcuts.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Fragment Mono: labels, metadata, keys and code. Never for sentences people read.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: The landing page's mono labels: the app name beside dictated text, times, counts, Network: Offline. In sh-text-muted.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Dense metadata in lists; the smallest text in the system.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, terminal text and file paths, in the app and on the site.

groups.name: Serif
groups.note: Bodoni Moda italic: the name, and words that have just been spoken. Never for interface text.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name, set live until drawn logo files exist: 24px in the site header, 20px in the About window.

styles.name: spoken
styles.usage: A dictated line shown as a specimen on the site (clamp(1.5rem, 2.7u, 5rem)). Once per chapter.

spacing.note: 4 px base, from the brand book.

tokens.name: sh-space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; LED to key edge.

tokens.name: sh-space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls; the indicator inset from the screen corner.

tokens.name: sh-space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows; menu item padding.

tokens.name: sh-space-4
tokens.usage: Card and popover padding; the phone side margin; window content inset on small windows.

tokens.name: sh-space-5
tokens.usage: Keycap button side padding; the grid gutter; the row label column gap; the window content inset.

tokens.name: sh-space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups on a screen; the tablet side margin.

tokens.name: sh-space-7
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a site section.

tokens.name: sh-space-8
tokens.usage: The desktop side margin; section rhythm on phones.

tokens.name: sh-space-9
tokens.usage: Between site sections, the low end.

tokens.name: sh-space-10
tokens.usage: Between site sections.

tokens.name: sh-space-11
tokens.usage: Between site sections, the high end.

radius.note: Keycap corners: small and square-ish. Round only for the indicator.

tokens.name: sh-radius-xs
tokens.usage: The LED, tags, the caret's ends.

tokens.name: sh-radius-sm
tokens.usage: Every keycap and button, inputs, cards, rows, the meeting reminder (the landing page's 4 px).

tokens.name: sh-radius-md
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, the screenshot frame on the site.

tokens.name: sh-radius-full
tokens.usage: The indicator and avatars only.

shadow.note: Keys have travel: a solid side under the cap and a soft cast shadow. Pressed, the cap moves down by its travel minus 1 px and the side shrinks to 1 px.

tokens.name: sh-key-primary
tokens.usage: The primary keycap at rest (the landing page CTA).

tokens.name: sh-key-primary-down
tokens.usage: The primary keycap pressed, with translateY(3px).

tokens.name: sh-key
tokens.usage: Secondary keycaps and toggles at rest.

tokens.name: sh-key-down
tokens.usage: Secondary keycaps pressed, with translateY(2px).

tokens.name: sh-key-hint
tokens.usage: Inline key hints (fn, Ctrl+V) inside text: a 1 px side, no cast shadow.

tokens.name: sh-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and the meeting reminder, which float above the window or the desktop.

travel.note: How far a cap moves when pressed.

tokens.name: sh-travel-primary
tokens.usage: The primary keycap's press distance (its side is 4 px).

tokens.name: sh-travel
tokens.usage: Secondary keycaps and toggles (their side is 3 px).

tokens.name: sh-control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact app controls: toolbar buttons, segmented controls, menu rows.

tokens.name: sh-control-md
tokens.usage: Default app controls: buttons, inputs, toggles.

tokens.name: sh-control-lg
tokens.usage: Onboarding buttons, every control on a touch screen.

tokens.name: sh-control-xl
tokens.usage: The site CTA keycap (3.25rem).

tokens.name: sh-indicator
tokens.usage: The indicator on screen, ring included.

tokens.name: sh-sidebar
tokens.usage: The app sidebar width.

tokens.name: sh-row-label
tokens.usage: The label column of a row (the landing page's 6.5rem).

tokens.name: sh-measure
tokens.usage: Line length for running text on the site and in help.

duration.note: From the brand book, plus the key press. Under reduced motion every duration is 0 ms.

tokens.name: sh-dur-press
tokens.usage: A key going down.

tokens.name: sh-dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, focus, a key coming back up, ring color crossfades.

tokens.name: sh-dur-base
tokens.usage: Small transitions and every exit.

tokens.name: sh-dur-slow
tokens.usage: Panels, popovers and the meeting reminder entering.

tokens.name: sh-dur-reveal
tokens.usage: The word reveal, total. Once per screen or page.

tokens.name: sh-dur-pulse
tokens.usage: Half a pulse of the writing ring and the LED glow.

tokens.name: sh-dur-blink
tokens.usage: One caret blink cycle (the landing page's caret).

easing.note: Nothing bounces, overshoots or springs: a key goes down and comes back, and stops.

tokens.name: sh-ease-press
tokens.usage: A key going down (the landing page's press).

tokens.name: sh-ease-settle
tokens.usage: Entrances and a key coming back up.

tokens.name: sh-ease-leave
tokens.usage: Exits.

tokens.name: sh-ease-move
tokens.usage: Something moving from one place to another.

tokens.name: sh-ease-breathe
tokens.usage: The writing pulse and the LED glow.

tokens.name: sh-z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky headers and the title bar.

tokens.name: sh-z-popover
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: sh-z-overlay
tokens.usage: The indicator and the meeting reminder in their own always-on-top window.
